description: Pure character base stats per level and per job (external growth excluded)
coverage_note: Job stat mapping: 14/14 jobs (client 1.14). Per-level base values: 0/840 (140 levels × HP, MP, ATK, DEF, main, sub) - all null.
level_independent_rules: 1 main stat = 1 Attack; 4 sub stat = 1 Attack (Warrior STR/DEX, Bowman DEX/STR, Magician INT/LUK, Thief LUK/DEX).
Stat Prop. Damage = main×1% + sub×0.25%, rounded down to 0.1%.
Known level-scaled effects that are NOT base stats: item options '1/4/5/10레벨당 주 스탯(%)', PvP level adjustment (see incoming_damage_formula).
